title: Test model with context length within limit
description: Test to ensure the model works correctly when the context length is within the maximum limit
preconditions: Model is properly set up and running
steps: Send a request to the model with a total of 8000 tokens
expected_result: The model should process the request successfully without any error
assumptions: The model can handle up to 8192 tokens

title: Test model with context length exceeding limit
description: Test to ensure the model returns an error when the context length exceeds the maximum limit
preconditions: Model is properly set up and running
steps: Send a request to the model with a total of 9066 tokens
expected_result: The model should return an error with code 400 and message 'context_length_exceeded'
assumptions: The model can handle up to 8192 tokens

title: Test model with context length at limit
description: Test to ensure the model works correctly when the context length is exactly at the maximum limit
preconditions: Model is properly set up and running
steps: Send a request to the model with a total of 8192 tokens
expected_result: The model should process the request successfully without any error
assumptions: The model can handle up to 8192 tokens
